init_remote_spot_robot: create a RemoteSpot instance to relay motor commands to the robot's onboard Core via ROS topics
send_cmd_to_core: send a named command with positional and keyword arguments to the robot's Core over ROS
grasp_hand_depth_blocking: command the robot to grasp an object at a specified depth and block until the grasp completes
set_arm_joint_positions: set the robot arm joint positions with configurable travel time, max velocity, and max acceleration
power_on_and_stand: power on the remote robot, initialize it, and command it to stand with a blocking timeout
